summary: Himax Technologies, Inc. filed a Form 6-K disclosing that one of its equity-method investees entered into a definitive agreement to be acquired by an independent third-party semiconductor technology company for US$80 million in cash. Himax holds approximately 31% of the investee's fully diluted equity. It estimates a pre-tax gain on disposal of US$23-24 million upon closing, subject to working capital and net cash adjustments. The transaction is subject to customary conditions and regulatory approvals, expected to close in Q4 2026. Watch for closing conditions and regulatory clearance.
